name: Huu WP for WooCommerce
author: Hugo Calixto

sections.description:
Huu WP for WooCommerce allows you to display a WhatsApp button directly on WooCommerce products.

Customers can quickly contact the store through WhatsApp from:

• Single product pages
• Product loop (shop and category pages)

This helps stores answer questions faster and convert visitors into customers.

Features:

  • WhatsApp button on single product page
  • WhatsApp button on product loops
  • Compatible with WooCommerce default templates
  • Compatible with Storefront theme
  • Lightweight and simple configuration

Available Languages

  • English
  • Español
  • Português (Brasil)

Demo

Loop
https://hugocalixto.com/demos/tienda-15/

Single product
https://hugocalixto.com/demos/tienda-15/produto/bodegas-barbon/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wc-huu folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Huu WP Settings
  4. Configure the WhatsApp number and display options
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. The plugin works with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.
